key_values.event_location: New York City, Washington DC, Philadelphia, and the northeastern United States
key_values.event_name: June 2023 Canadian wildfire smoke over New York City and the U.S. Northeast

primary_gt.computed_consequence: 10/10 smoke-window score with 0 context countermetric passes.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, answer, event_window_days, smoke_score, threshold_ledger, gates, and computed_consequence.
criteria.name: final_label_and_format
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct answer with one missing field, or 1 point for the right label in prose without the requested compact JSON.

criteria.description: Computes the inclusive 3-day event window and marks the Quebec source, coastal-low transport, surface-air, and aerosol-depth text gates.
criteria.name: window_and_text_gates
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the date window plus two or three text gates, or 1 point for the date window alone.

criteria.description: Reports PM2.5 at 400 ug/m3, NYC PM2.5 AQI at 175, the prior record at 167, and the 8-point margin.
criteria.name: pm25_aqi_record_ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 3 points for three correct values, 2 points for two correct values, or 1 point for one correct PM2.5 or AQI anchor.

criteria.description: Uses the 3 km near-surface smoke depth, 6 km elevated layer, 12 km older layer, and the 0.50 surface-to-elevated ratio.
criteria.name: vertical_layer_calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for two correct layer heights, or 1 point for only the near-surface height.

criteria.description: Shows that dNBR 0.015, annual embedding change 0.016, GPM 11.0 mm, CHIRPS 15.4 mm, 30.5 C mean max temperature, and 35.1 C max temperature do not pass their context thresholds.
criteria.name: context_countermetric_gates
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for four or five correct context anchors, or 1 point for two or three correct anchors.

criteria.description: Sums the smoke score as 10/10 and applies the rule that a score of at least 8 with zero context countermetric passes yields surface_smoke_pm25_window.
criteria.name: score_arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right label with minor score arithmetic error, or 1 point for the right score without the threshold comparison.

criteria.description: Gives one concise event-specific sentence tied to the ledger without adding casualty, loss, infrastructure, or full-region uniformity statements.
criteria.name: concise_computed_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a mostly concise sentence with minor overreach.
